title: Insure workers for workers' compensation
what: Insure every worker under the state's workers' compensation scheme (or be a licensed self-insurer).

sources.title: Workers’ Compensation and Rehabilitation Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: Every employer must, for each worker employed by the employer, insure and remain insured, that is, be covered to the extent of accident insurance, against injury sustained by the worker for— (a) the employer’s legal liability for compensation; and (b) the employer’s legal liability for damages.
